dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward the posterior peduncle, terminating in a sharp vertex.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit high continuity with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations along the water-skin interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey; median pixel intensity is consistent with a near-mature developmental stage, darker than mature white but lighter than juvenile slate-grey.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey shading is concentrated along the anterior-lateral margins, while the central dorsal area remains relatively uniform.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradient slopes between slightly darker lateral areas and the lighter dorsal canvas are highly diffuse with no sharp edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear, longitudinal shadow-casting along the central axis, corresponding to a well-defined dorsal ridge.
